maya: Heads up — release pipeline blocked. typegen changed method signature for client.createEmbedding: param order swapped (model, input) -> (input, model) and tests are failing in sample-apps. Anyone else see this? :grimacing:

owen: Ugh. I saw a diff in the generated openapi client earlier. CI shows a failing contract test. Can you paste the diff? Did typegen bump major?

maya: ```
- createEmbedding(model: string, input: string[])
+ createEmbedding(input: string[], model?: string)
```

maya: Tests expect (model, input). This change is breaking and caused the SDK JS release job to abort (npm publish gated). Reverting generator didn't happen because of an auto-commit from typegen-bot.

typegen-bot: auto-regenerated types at 1780401210 (semver=minor) — PR #531

samir: CI log shows 412 on publish step: changelog missing 'Unreleased' header — release script refused to cut. Also e2e flakiness in auth retry tests after the retry middleware parity change.

jen: Noticed the auth/retry tweak in JS SDK added exponential backoff default. That changed timing in sample-apps e2e and flakes. We should pin retry policy in tests to deterministic values.

owen: For the immediate release hold: option A) revert the auto-gen commit and pin typegen version in package.json; B) update sample-apps & tests to the new signature and ship a semver-major. Which do we want?

maya: Prefer revert for patch release. We'll schedule a deliberate semver-major with a migration doc later.

samir: I'll open a hotfix PR to revert and add a pre-publish check to fail if any public API surface changes (diff against last published). Also will add a changelog linter in CI.

maya: Thanks. Can you also add a small script to run typegen with `--stable-params` flag? That flag exists but wasn't used by bot.

typegen-bot: noted — will stop auto-commits until review. :thumbsup:

owen: Also, can devex add a gating check so typegen-bot's PRs require at least one runtime-engineer LG? Otherwise auto-merge will keep biting us.

jen: I'll update the release checklist: require changelog entry + api-diff check + retry determinism in tests.

samir: I'm pushing hotfix PR now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/542 — includes revert and CI fixes.

maya: local confirm — sample-apps tests pass with revert. Thanks team.

ci-bot: publish-job aborted: unpublished package version conflict detected

maya: Will wait for PR to merge and then try cut again. cc @owen @jen
